ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: speaker
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Chairs the council's meetings and speaks for the colony. A good speaker slowly builds the colony's trust in the council.

duties.li: Everyone's trust in the council rises a little each day.
The speaker is more persuasive (social impact and negotiation).

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} plans to clear {PAWN_possessive} throat at the next supper and see whether the room goes quiet, which would surprise {PAWN_nameDef} most of all.
{PAWN_nameDef} promises short meetings. Nobody believes it.
{PAWN_nameDef} expects to be asked to settle three arguments by the end of the week, and hopes to settle two of them.

li.text: {PAWN_nameDef} says the council has stopped listening, and promises meetings where everyone gets a word in.
{PAWN_nameDef} wants the colony's quarrels brought to the table before they turn into feuds.
{PAWN_nameDef} promises to speak for the colony plainly, and to say no when no is the answer.
{PAWN_nameDef} promises shorter meetings that actually decide something.

ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: marshal
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Leads the colony's defense: runs the drills, sets the watches and is first to the wall when raiders come.

duties.li: Drills train everyone half again as fast.
Colonists aim and strike a little better.
The marshal fights better and holds steady under fire.

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} says the first thing {PAWN_pronoun} will do is walk the wall and move two of the sandbags a hand's width to the left.
{PAWN_nameDef} talks of drills at dawn, to general groaning.
{PAWN_nameDef} wants to know where everyone sleeps, in case.

li.text: {PAWN_nameDef} talks of the last raid, and wants the weak side of the wall seen to before the next one.
{PAWN_nameDef} says a quiet spell is when drills count, and wants everyone at them.
{PAWN_nameDef} promises a proper watch at night, with nobody sleeping through it.

ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: quartermaster
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Keeps the stores, counts the silver and haggles with traders.

duties.li: Answers to dilemmas that cost food, wood or silver cost a quarter less.
The quartermaster gets better prices from traders.

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} means to count the stores twice over, and expects to frown both times.
{PAWN_nameDef} wants a ledger of the stores, and says the cook will be the first name in it.
{PAWN_nameDef} says the next trader is going to regret coming.

li.text: {PAWN_nameDef} points at the empty shelves and promises meals put by before anyone goes hungry.
{PAWN_nameDef} says the stores are full enough to trade from, and means to drive a hard bargain.
{PAWN_nameDef} promises a count of the stores every week, and nothing left to rot.

ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: physician
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: The colony's chief doctor: runs the hospital, sets bones and decides who's fit to work.

duties.li: Everyone heals and fights off illness a little faster.
The physician tends wounds and operates more skillfully.

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} plans to wash {PAWN_possessive} hands, look over the sickbeds and make a list of what they lack.
{PAWN_nameDef} intends to ask everyone how they are sleeping, and write the answers down.
{PAWN_nameDef} says the first rule is clean hands, and the second rule is also clean hands.

li.text: {PAWN_nameDef} has been at the sickbeds lately, and wants a proper place for the ill and the hurt.
{PAWN_nameDef} says the medicine is running low, and wants more made or bought before it is needed.
{PAWN_nameDef} promises that nobody who is hurt will wait for a doctor.

ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: steward
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Looks after the colony's spirits: feasts, festivals, and keeping expectations down to earth.

duties.li: Everyone's standards rise a quarter more slowly.
The steward gets more out of recreation.

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} wants to know what everyone would like for the next feast.
{PAWN_nameDef} says a colony that never celebrates forgets why it bothers, and means to fix that.
{PAWN_nameDef} says a lamp should be left burning in the common room of an evening, as a start.

li.text: {PAWN_nameDef} says spirits are low, and promises more evenings worth staying up for.
{PAWN_nameDef} promises feasts on the days that matter, and less grumbling in between.
